description: Returns one statutory EU compliance deadline by its exact id, with the Official Journal source, quote, SHA-256 and dated history of changes. Use it when you already have an id from compliance_list_deadlines; use compliance_list_deadlines to search by law or dates or to get several at once. Input: id (required, 1 to 80 lowercase letters/digits/hyphens, case-sensitive, e.g. eudr-large-medium-operators). Output: as_of, verified and deadline with obligation, date, previous_date, status, days_until, source URL, quote, SHA-256 and history. An unknown id returns the error deadline_not_found. Data is bundled from the acts and reviewed as of verified; days_until is computed today. 26 obligations under 12 laws from 19 acts; 11 dates have moved through 7 amending acts, each earlier date kept in history with its act, article and quote. Terms: read-only; MCP calls are never charged. Without a key, metered routes give 10 successful answers a day free, as short samples (up to 3 records, without file proof, history or paging cursor) where a paid HTTP address exists (unmetered routes are unlimited); errors do not count. On the paid HTTP routes, errors are free, and so are empty answers except a sanctions name search with no match when every loaded list it checks is fresh (lists not loaded yet are named in the answer). An optional API key keeps its prepaid-credit policy. When the free answers run out, the error names the HTTP alternative.

id.description: Exact case-sensitive id from compliance_list_deadlines, 1 to 80 lowercase ASCII letters/digits/hyphens, e.g. eudr-large-medium-operators

name: compliance_get_deadline
title: Get one EU compliance deadline
